translations.web: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
translations.bsb: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
translations.kjv: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
translations.asv: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing: Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.
